# Hold Payment

Hold Payment is documented as separate operations:

- [Create hold](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/hold-payment/create)
- [Charge hold](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/hold-payment/charge)
- [Dismiss hold](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/hold-payment/dismiss)
- [Get hold status](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/hold-payment/status)

## Notes (extraction)

- The `.html` URL serves this content. The extensionless URL redirects to a directory URL that returned HTTP 404 during verification. EN, RU and UZ agree on the operations and link targets; labels and introductory prose are translated.
